columns.name: ALLOC_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a row in an allocation rule.

columns.name: RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for an allocation rule.

columns.name: RULE_NAME
columns.description: Name of an allocation rule.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of an allocation rule.

columns.name: DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Display name of an allocation rule.

columns.name: RULESET_ID
columns.description: Rule set identifier used when an allocation rule belongs to a rule set.

columns.name: RULE_SEQUENCE
columns.description: The order in which rules in a rule set are run.

columns.name: FUNCTION_SEQUENCE
columns.description: The order in which rule components are run.

columns.name: ALLOC_BLOCK
columns.description: Information on an allocation component in XML format.

columns.name: CUSTOMCALC_BLOCK
columns.description: Information on a formula component in XML format.

columns.name: APP_NAME
columns.description: Essbase application name on which an allocation rule is defined.

columns.name: DB_NAME
columns.description: Essbase db name on which an allocation rule is defined.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the allocation rule can be generated.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date up to which the allocation rule can be generated.
